svg.text: numbers show step order within each flow · circles colored by lane
5* = conditional (only when task.status == 'submitted' at edit time) · 4r = read-only step (no writes)
Only Flow 3 reaches Cohere · only Flow 7 reaches the filesystem · Flow 8 is the only pure read
Dashed connector between API → BackgroundTasks signals an in-process function call (FastAPI add_task), not a network hop
